subject: CAIQ submission & evidence ask — tenant isolation & KMS

Subject: CAIQ submission & evidence ask — tenant isolation & KMS

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this on. We're preparing our CAIQ assessment for Greencrest's procurement review and have a couple of focused asks related to tenant isolation and key management. We received Redwood's CAIQ responses but need control-level artifacts for the following items so we can close our internal review:

- CSA CCM Controls: IDM-01 (tenant segregation), CRY-02 (KMS key rotation), LOG-07 (runtime telemetry sampling).
- Example artifacts requested: a short diagram/description showing tenant separation at the network and runtime layer, a KMS rotation policy + proof of rotation (signed key-rotation event), and a 24-hour sample of runtime request logs with sensitive fields redacted.
- Desired formats: PDF for policy, TXT or log for runtime samples, and a ZIP containing any exported evidence.

Can you confirm owners, expected delivery date, and whether you need an NDA/secure transfer method? We're hoping to have these artifacts uploaded by EOD Apr 2 for our audit window.

Thanks — let me know if we should schedule a quick sync.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Security
Greencrest Labs

- Delivery target: aiming to upload a preliminary evidence bundle by 2028-04-02 17:00 PDT. If anything changes we'll flag earlier.

Kimberly / Marissa / Elena — quick mapping and ask list from our side:

- Tenant isolation (IDM-01): we will provide a 1-page architecture diagram (PDF) and a short narrative describing logical tenant boundaries, VPC/subnet separation, and runtime process isolation between customer jobs. Expect file: tenant_isolation_diagram.pdf.

- KMS key rotation (CRY-02): we'll include the KMS rotation policy (keystore_rotation.pdf) and a redacted rotation audit event (keystore_rotation_event-20280315.json) — if Greencrest prefers CSV or PDF let us know. We will not share private keys; only rotation metadata and signatures.

- Runtime logs (LOG-07): Marissa will curate a 24-hour sample filtered to non-PHI tokens, with redaction notes. File plan: runtime_logs_sample.log (with accompanying redaction_manifest.txt).

Logistics: Marissa, please prepare the evidence bundle zip and upload to our secure intake bucket. Elena, please confirm that redaction to remove any customer PII is acceptable and whether you need the sample hashed instead of plain text.

I'll be on standby for any control clarifications.

-Jonas
Head of Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@greencrest.com>

Thanks Jonas — redaction is fine. Two quick clarifications from Greencrest:

1) For the rotation audit event, could you redact any internal ARNs but retain timestamps and the signer identity? That will satisfy our legal team.
2) For the runtime log sample, please replace any user identifiers with consistent pseudonyms (e.g., user_001) and include a short mapping manifest explaining pseudonymization.

We do not require an NDA to receive the redacted artifacts, but we'll need the subprocessor list for KMS (who operates the HSM/KMS, any cloud provider regions used for key storage).

If you can confirm those changes and upload by EOD Apr 2 (we requested earlier but can accept Apr 3 by 12:00 PDT if helpful) we'll mark the control as in-review on our side.

Best,
Elena
